about.title: About Us
about.intro: Alumas is a digital health technology platform uniting personal health management, healthcare professionals, and verified institutions into a unified healthcare super-app.
about.whatWeDoDesc: We create a seamless experience for appointment booking, health tracking, family care, institution discovery, home care, cross-border care, and secure health data sharing.
about.approachDesc: Alumas is not a medical diagnostic system. It provides tools for organizing health records, tracking vital metrics, and sharing clinical data with authorized healthcare providers.
about.trustDesc: Health data is treated with strict confidentiality. Access permissions are strictly controlled by role and patient consent; users maintain full ownership over sharing preferences.
